tools.name: upload_and_purge_old_backup_files
tools.description: Uploads local database backup files older than the given age to an S3 bucket and then deletes the local copies.

params.name: minimum_age_days
params.description: Only files older than this many days are handled

tools.code:
import time
from pathlib import Path

import boto3

s3_client_for_backups = boto3.client("s3")


def upload_and_purge_old_backup_files(backup_directory: str, bucket_name: str, minimum_age_days: int) -> dict:
    directory_path_object = Path(backup_directory)
    age_cutoff_timestamp_in_seconds = time.time() - minimum_age_days * 86400
    list_of_uploaded_and_removed_file_names = []
    for each_candidate_backup_file in directory_path_object.glob("*.dump"):
        modification_time_of_candidate = each_candidate_backup_file.stat().st_mtime
        if modification_time_of_candidate >= age_cutoff_timestamp_in_seconds:
            continue
        destination_object_key_name = f"backups/{each_candidate_backup_file.name}"
        s3_client_for_backups.upload_file(
            str(each_candidate_backup_file), bucket_name, destination_object_key_name
        )
        each_candidate_backup_file.unlink()
        list_of_uploaded_and_removed_file_names.append(each_candidate_backup_file.name)
    return {"processed": list_of_uploaded_and_removed_file_names}

tools.name: run_sql_migration_script
tools.description: Runs a SQL migration file against a Postgres database using psql and records the migration name in the schema_migrations table.
tools.code:
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

import psycopg2
from langchain_core.tools import tool


def _record_migration(database_url: str, migration_name: str) -> None:
    with psycopg2.connect(database_url) as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
        cur.execute(
            "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_migrations (name text PRIMARY KEY, applied_at timestamptz DEFAULT now())"
        )
        cur.execute(
            "INSERT INTO schema_migrations (name) VALUES (%s) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING",
            (migration_name,),
        )


@tool
def run_sql_migration_script(database_url: str, migration_path: str) -> str:
    """Apply a SQL migration file and record it."""
    path = Path(migration_path)
    if not path.is_file() or path.suffix != ".sql":
        return "error: migration_path must be an existing .sql file"
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["psql", database_url, "-v", "ON_ERROR_STOP=1", "-f", str(path)],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=600,
    )
    if result.returncode != 0:
        return f"migration failed: {result.stderr.strip()[:500]}"
    _record_migration(database_url, path.stem)
    return f"applied {path.stem}"
